Siddhattha, the lamp of the world,
the healer of all the world.
and he sat upon that leafy mat.
Because I gave that leaf back then,
I do not know a state of misery;
this is the fruit of giving a leaf.
The four analytical knowledges and these eight liberations have been realized,
as well as the six direct knowledges.
“Such is the teaching of the Buddha.
Thus indeed did the venerable elder Paṇṇadāyaka recite these verses.
This is the first legend of the elder Paṇṇadāyaka.
